meta_tools.name: codespar_pay
meta_tools.description: Propose one or more Pix payments to named payees of the month. This does NOT pay: it creates an execution in `drafted` that the core checks against the mandate and, depending on the approval mode, asks the person or runs. Use the payee alias from list_bills (escola, mercado, funcionaria, contas). Amounts are in BRL cents.

payee.description: A payee alias from list_bills. Never a raw Pix key the person typed in the chat.

total_minor.description: Optional. What you believe the total is. The core recomputes it and yours is only recorded.

meta_tools.name: codespar_ledger
meta_tools.description: Read the receipt of a settled payment by receipt id, or list the executions of this run with their states.

local_tools.name: list_bills
local_tools.description: The bills of the current month: payee alias, name, amount in BRL cents, due date and whether it was already paid in this mandate window. Read-only.
